'''Ecklin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] representative to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Makeb]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. He was stationed at the Hutt Cartel's embassy in [[Talaos City]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. In the [[City/Legends|city]], Ecklin was approached by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] strike team that convinced him to betray his masters, and grant them access to the embassy archives.
